content: Official WordPress menu.php and Developer Reference show custom_menu_order is a boolean gate; menu_order receives and returns the array of menu slugs. Core snapshots the default slug order before invoking menu_order, flips returned/default arrays, then sorts actual $menu items; unknown/unlisted menu items should not be invented outside a coherent menu/order pair. GigPress changes global $menu inside its menu_order callback and emits a custom separator slug; this mutates menu after core snapshots defaults. Core comparator directly indexes default order for items absent from the filtered map, so an unknown/mismatched slug can produce an undefined-key warning. Specific warning root cause is probable but not fully confirmed from report alone; instrument active plugins, hooks, and $menu before/after filters.
